messages:
maria: Setting up a 25m pre-QBR triage for Alderon (QBR Wed 9AM PT). Scope: token econ - embeddings heavy, 90-day spend forecast, and enablement gaps. Can we do 4pm PT today? cc @kevin @harper

kevin: 4pm PT works. Can someone confirm their embedding dim? I think they moved to 768 last sprint which changes cost modeling.

harper: Confirmed: switched to 768-d two weeks ago. Also they enabled hourly batch jobs that run at peak; that drove yesterday's spike. I'll pull logs.

finance-bot: Billing alert: Alderon usage spike +92% vs baseline triggered rule embed_batch_spike. Invoice flag set (B-8042).

maria: Agenda: 1) current run-rate + two growth scenarios (x1.3, x2) 2) quick mitigation levers (batch windowing, KV cache, reserve vs throttle) 3) enablement tasks + owners.

kevin: I'll bring per-route token counts and a tiny script: `./tools/forecast --account alderon --days 90`

harper: From enablement: their SDK integration doesn't use prefix caching and retries cause duplicate embeddings. I'll demo a minimal caching patch and a low-friction deployment plan.

maria: Can finance post a short commit vs on-demand calc before the sync? Need numbers for the QBR pre-read.

kevin: Rough math (quick):
- current run-rate: $12.3k/mo
- growth x1.3 -> $16k/mo
- growth x2 -> $24.6k/mo
Assumes avg 3 vectors/request @768-d. Will refine with route CSV.

eng-support: caching snippet (pseudo):
```
# simple prefix cache
if cache.has(prefix):
  return cache.get(prefix)
else:
  vec = embeddings.call(prefix)
  cache.set(prefix, vec)
  return vec
```

maria: Thanks. Locking 4pm PT. If anyone can't join, drop notes here and tag owners. I'll send pre-read to Alderon PM with the forecast and mitigations. :white_check_mark:

harper: I'll own follow-ups: rollout cache patch + checklist for batch windowing. ETA EOD.

finance-bot: Follow-up doc: /shared/finance/alderon-cost-options (reserved vs throttle vs burst) created.

kevin: Posting per-route CSV now. See attached.

maria: Great team. End.
